name: New Murchison Gold Limited
summary: New Murchison Gold Limited engages in the exploration, development, and operation of gold mines in Australia. The company primarily explores for gold. Its flagship property is the Garden Gully property that includes 619 square kilometers tenure package located in the Abbotts Greenstone Belt, north of Meekatharra. The company was formerly known as Ora Gold Limited and changed its name to New Murchison Gold Limited in November 2024. New Murchison Gold Limited was incorporated in 2003 and is based in West Perth, Australia.
